title: Install orientation heuristics and customer quirk log — Aug 05 2027
content:
Meeting: Install orientation + heuristics run-through (weekly) — 2027-08-05
Owner: Maya Iqbal
Attendees: Jonas Park, Felix Rios, Priya Menon, Sam Carter, Heather Liu (SRE), Diego Alvarez (Solutions)
Purpose: consolidate recurring customer quirks, update orientation checklist, and track short-term blocker remediation.

Summary
- Three installs completed this week (NimbusCo staging VPC, CardinalPay on-prem pilot, Finova EU private-hosted). All green functionally but each exposed unique infra quirks that we should fold into the runbook.
- Priority risk: certificate rotation timing in HSM-backed installs (Finova) caused brief control-plane races leading to agent reconnections.
- Operational action: add MTU and ephemeral-port checks to preflight and a lightweight TCP keepalive tweak for SSE endpoints.

Installs (short notes)
1) NimbusCo (staging VPC) — completed 8/3
   - Symptom: intermittent streaming disconnects on long-lived SSE chat sessions at ~6–7 minutes.
   - Root cause: overlay network MTU mismatch between customer transit gateway and our egress NAT; large blocks caused occasional fragmentation/timeouts on SSE chunked transfer.
   - Mitigation applied: lowered client-side MSS and enabled path MTU discovery fallback; customer to validate across regions.

2) CardinalPay (on-prem pilot) — completed 8/2
   - Symptom: auth failures during high auth churn; machine auth via SSSD was timing out.
   - Notes: the customer's domain controllers throttle auth when bind frequency spikes. Added jittered backoff to our node provisioning account and queued batch binds.
   - Follow-up: Ops to dial back concurrent provisioner threads (owner: Felix, due 2027-08-09).

3) Finova (EU private-hosted) — live 8/4 (soft launch)
   - Symptom: control-plane agent restarted during HSM cert rotation window; caused short-lived rekeying race and API 503s.
   - Diagnosis: rotation script and agent both attempted PKCS#11 token re-initialization; token temporarily locked by rotation process.
   - Short-term fix: serialized rotation with advisory lock via Conductor; long-term: move to staged cert swap with prefetch and parity validation (owner: Priya, spike due 2027-08-13).

Recurring/Notable Quirks
- Ephemeral port exhaustion on legacy load-balancer configurations (older F5 setups). Observed high TIME_WAIT accumulation under burst traffic; recommend enabling socket reuse and tuning tcp_tw_reuse where allowed.
- NFS mount flakiness when customers mount with root-squash + large fan-out; suggest we recommend explicit node-local caching layer (small in-memory cache) in runbook.
- KMS/HSM latency spikes when customer key rotation coincides with peak inferencing; log correlation ID to KMS API in agent logs for faster triage.

Telemetry & Observability
- Add MTU mismatch metric: compare observed MTU from traceroute/pmtu vs configured interface. Tag metrics with customer_region and network_vendor.
- Add an SSE reconnect histogram and label for 'fragmentation_detected' to surface this class of issue early.
- Action: Sam to add PMTU and SSE histograms to the deployment health dashboard (due 2027-08-11).

Decisions Made
- Preflight checklist will now include: MTU test, ephemeral-port stress test, SSSD bind-rate simulation, and HSM cert rotation dry-run.
- For HSM-backed installs, enforce a rotation maintenance window in the SLA doc and schedule advisor webhook that pauses agent restart policies during rotation.

Open Action Items
- Felix Rios: throttle provisioner concurrency in on-prem bootstrap tool — due 2027-08-09
- Priya Menon: prototype serialized HSM rotation with prefetch and validation step — due 2027-08-13
- Sam Carter: dashboard tiles for PMTU and SSE reconnect histograms — due 2027-08-11
- Jonas Park: update install-runbook preflight section + add check commands and expected outputs — due 2027-08-10
- Maya Iqbal: write a short customer communication template explaining temporary reconnection behavior during HSM rotation — due 2027-08-06

Questions / Follow-ups
- Do we want to ship a lightweight agent flag (--inhibit-rotation-restart) for customers who prefer to coordinate HSM rotations with us? (Tentative yes; need safety review.)
- Should runbook include recommended load-balancer configuration snippets for F5 and nginx to avoid TIME_WAIT build-up? (Action: Jonas to draft examples.)

Notes to self / messy bits
- Some customers run odd iptables rules that break PMTU tests — need to document a set of expected passthrough rules.
- Consider adding a small pcap collection step to our preflight script when fragmentation is suspected.

Next sync
- Weekly install orientation: 2027-08-12 11:00 PT; invite will use the 'private-deploys-orientation' calendar. Agenda: review action items, triage any new quirks, and decide on 'agent flag' safety plan.

Raw links / debug artifacts
- JIRA: PD-4873 (HSM rotation race)
- Runbook draft: /display/PD/Install+Runbook+v2
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-deploy-installer/pull/212

End of notes.
